# Supermatter Delamination
Delamination occurs when the Supermatter can no longer recover from the amount of stress applied to it.
When recovery fails, the crystal enters an unstable state where damage accelerates faster than the crystal can repair itself.
A delamination event is considered a critical station emergency.
## Emergency Response
If a Supermatter begins to destabilize, engineering personnel should immediately attempt to reduce stress on the crystal.
Priority actions:
1. Disable destabilizing equipment.
2. Correct dangerous chamber conditions.
3. Deploy containment measures if required.
Failure to stabilize the crystal will result in complete structural collapse.
## Final Emergency Procedures
If delamination cannot be prevented:
1. Notify the crew of the ongoing Supermatter emergency. 2. Recommend evacuation procedures. 3. Distribute approved protective equipment. 4. Prepare engineering equipment for post-event cleanup.
## Delamination Cleanup
During complete failure, the original Supermatter crystal collapses and transforms into cascad crystals.
Cascad crystals are extremely hardened structures that expand through surrounding materials.
